text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all today too!
Alrighty, off to do my warm-ups~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is always 'ordinary.' Once I realized that,
it began catching my eye even more. For instance, in our recent training—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *wheeze* *gasp*~. Man, I really know I need to build up my stamina,
but my body just isn't keeping up at all~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just how it goes! Can I try it again tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She never beat herself up excessively over her shortcomings.
And during her solo training yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Let me see...
It looks to me like your acceleration coming off the final corner is still falling just a bit short.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh, I gotcha!
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched as she readily and positively took advice
from a fellow horsegirl who was practically her rival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The world of racing is cutthroat. It demands extraordinary speed, obsession, drive,
and sheer luck.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that sense, competing with a flat, easygoing mindset
like Matikanetannhauser's would normally prove difficult.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaack~!
Now then, what menu item are we starting with today?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the Track & Field meet, after all!
I'm racing Bourbon-san again, so we'll wanna tune things up, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she can remain this consistently 'ordinary,' that changes everything.
choice_data_list: ...I'm really looking forward to seeing how you do moving forward.
...I'm really looking forward to seeing how you do moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-What brought that on all of a sudden?!
Jeez, you're... you're totally making me blush here~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to keep an 'ordinary,' level-headed attitude and keep striving forward no matter what happens.
That is an incredible trait that serves as a tremendous advantage for growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the day of the Track & Field meet arrived. A 1600m turf mile race.
The undisputed center of attention was, without a doubt, Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's run in the last mock race was simply breathtaking!
She blew the field away by a mile, so I have high expectations today too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like Matikanetannhauser is running too.
If I recall, she couldn't find her burst last time and looked pretty underwhelming, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
............Mun. True, last time was totally mediocre.
All the more reason to try my absolute hardest today~! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All runners are loaded into the gates.
And they're off on the 1600m turf!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon settles into second position.
Matikanetannhauser sits in fifth as they blow past the 600m mark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now entering the sweeping fourth turn!
Mihono Bourbon on the outside in second—who will make the first move?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Alright, time to accelerate and catch Bourbon-san!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon breaks away! Mihono Bourbon surges ahead as they pass the 200m mark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (W-What is that acceleration~?! —Even so, still!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ['...I'm really looking forward to seeing how you do moving forward.']

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ['...I'm really looking forward to seeing how you do moving forward.']

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(—That doesn't matter!
I won't settle for anything less than first place!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon still holds the lead—100 meters to go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The pack gives chase! Will they catch her, or will she hold on?!
In the end, it's—Mihono Bourbon, crossing the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Man, Mihono Bourbon really is on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
And... Matikanetannhauser too! She took fourth, but showed some sharp closing speed
with a fantastic late charge! We'll definitely have to keep an eye on her moving forward~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze* *pant* *haaaah*...~
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay~.
Getting treated to food even though I only got fourth place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man... I still couldn't reach the top today, though.
Guess I'm still taking home the 'Need-More-Work Grand Prize.'
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Ehehe, despite how it turned out,
I honestly felt like I made some real progress today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't really explain it well, but like,
there was this fire roaring inside me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
When I remembered what you said the other day about 'looking forward to seeing how I do,'
my heart just went *whoooosh* and flared up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without feeling weighed down, she managed to turn words into fuel.
Her everyday nature was supporting her growth far more than I had ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Meeting you might've been even luckier than I thought, Trainer. ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Here's to working together from now on, too!
So with that in mind... here, let's split it half-and-half!
